blocks.html: Most Robinsons Malls are set to close for two days in observance of Maundy Thursday (March 24) and Good Friday (March 25). For those who will be needing a quick run to the grocery or are planning to catch a movie, please be guided by Robinsons Malls’ schedule for the holy week: On Maundy Thursday, all malls are closed except for Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Luisita, Summit Ridge Promenade, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Starmills. On Good Friday, all malls are closed except for Robinson Place Antipolo, Robinsons Luisita and Summit Ridge Promenade. Regular operations resume on Black Saturday for all Robinsons Malls.
